notes: Eleven States/UTs have reported higher percentage share than the All India average in suicides with causes such as
‘Illness’. Andhra Pradesh and Pondicherry (36.2%), UT of Andaman and Nicobar Islands (35.7%) and Goa (32.0%)
reported at least 1 out of 3 suicides due to ‘Illness’ lone.
Thirteen States/UTs have reported higher share than the All India average in suicides caused due to ‘Family Problem’
during the year. Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Tripura, Pondicherry, Bihar & Maharashtra etc. reported higher share of suicides
